variants.standard: The evaluated chain is structurally complete for governed preview analysis.
variants.enterprise: The governance pack presents a stable preview-validation posture with no runtime authority granted.
variants.compliance: The evaluated output remains within static governance review boundaries and does not authorize execution.
variants.technical: Schema, fixture, and governance layers are aligned for non-executing preview interpretation.

variants.standard: Provider, binding, trust, approval, rollback, and tenant signals were interpreted according to static governance rules.
variants.enterprise: Technical validation supports the reported governance posture without enabling runtime behavior.
variants.compliance: Technical evidence aligns with the control posture described in the blocked-reason and readiness outputs.
variants.technical: Cross-schema consistency checks and readiness derivation were evaluated at the structural layer only.
variants.concise: Structural checks only; no runtime behavior involved.

variants.standard: The chain is blocked by one or more governance or structural conditions.
variants.enterprise: Operational readiness is blocked pending remediation of the identified governance conditions.
variants.compliance: Control posture prevents advancement due to explicit blocked conditions.
variants.technical: Blocked reasons prevent readiness progression and override otherwise valid structural signals.

variants.standard: A known mismatch note is preserved for validation visibility.
variants.enterprise: A documented consistency note remains visible for governance transparency.
variants.compliance: A preserved mismatch is recorded and not normalized away.
variants.technical: Known sentinel inconsistency remains explicit for regression and consistency-review purposes.

variants.standard: Address the highest-priority blocker first, then re-evaluate the chain under the same governance rules.
variants.enterprise: Remediation should begin with the most significant governance blocker and proceed in ownership order.
variants.compliance: Evidence-backed remediation is required before higher readiness can be reconsidered.
variants.technical: Correct the blocked layer, preserve traceability, and rerun static validation after remediation.

variants.standard: The output remains within static governance review boundaries.
variants.enterprise: Compliance posture is represented through blocked reasons, trust state, approval state, and tenant compliance signals.
variants.compliance: Required controls and evidence paths are explicitly represented in the preview and reporting layers.
variants.technical: Compliance-facing outputs are derived from the same governed fields used by preview and harness layers.

variants.standard: Audit-facing artifacts preserve provenance, blocked reasons, trace expectations, and validation outcomes.
variants.enterprise: Audit readiness is supported by structured exports and stable governance terminology.
variants.compliance: Audit evidence remains exportable without requiring runtime execution or provider activation.
variants.technical: Synthetic traces, harness results, and consistency failures provide reproducible review surfaces.
